facts.note: Rosa says that when the temple struck ten, her kitchen clock showed a quarter past ten, and that she keeps it fast on purpose.
Lina came down at twenty-three minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
The piano began at twelve minutes to eleven and stopped at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
The hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed three minutes past eleven.
